KISWAHILI — MOCK EXAM #11
====

GRADE: Grade 4
SUBJECT: KISWAHILI
TIME ALLOWED: 2 hours
TOTAL MARKS: 80
EXAM BODY: KPSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Wingi wa “mtoto” ni: (1 mark)
   A. mitoto
   B. watoto
   C. mato
   D. kitoto

2. When practising Sarufi 1.4.2 Vitenzi, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Sarufi 1.4.2 Vitenzi.
   B. Avoid reading anything related to Sarufi 1.4.2 Vitenzi.
   C. Use insults to “practise” Sarufi 1.4.2 Vitenzi.
   D. Copy random text without understanding Sarufi 1.4.2 Vitenzi.

3. When practising Matamshi Bora Sauti, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Copy random text without understanding Matamshi Bora Sauti.

   C. Use insults to “practise” Matamshi Bora Sauti.
   D. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Matamshi Bora Sauti.

4. Ni sentensi ipi iliyo sahihi kisarufi? (1 mark)
   A. Anasoma mwanafunzi kitabu ya.
   B. Kitabu anasoma mwanafunzi kwa.
   C. Mwanafunzi anasoma kitabu.
   D. Mwanafunzi anasoma vitabu mzuri.
